## Count Call Records

This path returns the number of call records of each outcome. Calls without an outcome yet, still ringing, are left out.

| Method | Path                          |
| ------ | ----------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/call-records/counts` |

### Query Parameters

| Name      | In    | Type | Default | Allowed                                                                           | Description                                                                  |
| --------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `search`  | query | str  |         |                                                                                   | Substring of the ICID or of an identity of the caller or the callee.         |
| `start`   | query | str  |         |                                                                                   | Inclusive lower bound of the request time, RFC 3339. Unbounded when omitted. |
| `end`     | query | str  |         |                                                                                   | Exclusive upper bound of the request time, RFC 3339. Unbounded when omitted. |
| `outcome` | query | str  |         | `answered`, `cancelled`, `busy`, `rejected`, `no_answer`, `unavailable`, `failed` | Outcome to include. Repeatable.                                              |

### Response Fields

| Field         | Type | Description                        |
| ------------- | ---- | ---------------------------------- |
| `answered`    | int  | Calls answered, ended or not.      |
| `cancelled`   | int  | Calls the caller cancelled.        |
| `busy`        | int  | Calls to a busy callee.            |
| `rejected`    | int  | Calls the callee declined.         |
| `no_answer`   | int  | Calls that rang without an answer. |
| `unavailable` | int  | Calls to an unavailable callee.    |
| `failed`      | int  | Calls that failed.                 |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "answered": 128,
        "cancelled": 9,
        "busy": 4,
        "rejected": 1,
        "no_answer": 6,
        "unavailable": 3,
        "failed": 2
    }
}
```

## Get a Call Record

This path returns a specific call record.

| Method | Path                        |
| ------ | --------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/call-records/{id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name | Type | Description        |
| ---- | ---- | ------------------ |
| `id` | int  | Record identifier. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                    |
| ----- | ------------------------------ |
| `404` | No record has this identifier. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": 43,
        "icid": "2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c",
        "session_id": "b95c5d87f77821@10.45.0.3",
        "calling_party": [
            "sip:+15550000002@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
        ],
        "caller_impi": "001010000000002@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "requested_party": "tel:+15550000001",
        "called_party": "tel:+15550000001",
        "requested_at": "2026-10-26T18:30:41.019Z",
        "delivery_start_at": "2026-10-26T18:30:50.552Z",
        "sip_status": 486,
        "outcome": "busy",
        "ended_by": "callee",
        "alerted": true,
        "media": [],
        "in_progress": false,
        "incomplete": false
    }
}
```

## Get Call Record Retention Policy

This path returns how long call records are kept.

| Method | Path                             |
| ------ | -------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/call-records/retention` |

### Response Fields

| Field  | Type | Description                           |
| ------ | ---- | ------------------------------------- |
| `days` | int  | Number of days call records are kept. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "days": 90
    }
}
```

## Update Call Record Retention Policy

This path changes how long call records are kept, from their next pruning.

| Method | Path                             |
| ------ | -------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/call-records/retention` |

### Request Body

| Field  | Type | Required | Description |
| ------ | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `days` | int  | Yes      | 1–3650.     |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "days": 30
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "days": 30
    }
}
```

# Cluster

A cluster is a set of Ella IMS nodes that share their settings, users and call records.

Reading the cluster requires Admin, Read Only or Network Manager. The other paths, except [Join a Cluster](#join-a-cluster), require Admin, and an access token: an API token gets `403`.

## Get the Cluster

This path returns the node that answered, its cluster, and every member.

| Method | Path              |
| ------ | ----------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/cluster` |

### Response Fields

| Field                       | Type    | Description                                                                            |
| --------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `node_id`                   | string  | ID of the node that answered.                                                          |
| `cluster_id`                | string  | ID of the cluster.                                                                     |
| `clustered`                 | boolean | The node has a `cluster` block.                                                        |
| `leader_id`                 | string  | ID of the leader. Absent when there is none.                                           |
| `term`                      | int     | Election term.                                                                         |
| `applied_index`             | int     | Last log entry applied by the node.                                                    |
| `commit_index`              | int     | Last log entry committed by the cluster.                                               |
| `schema`                    | int     | Database schema version of the cluster.                                                |
| `healthy`                   | boolean | The cluster is healthy. Only from the leader.                                          |
| `failure_tolerance`         | int     | Voters that can fail without stopping writes. Only from the leader.                    |
| `members[].node_id`         | string  | ID of the member.                                                                      |
| `members[].address`         | string  | Cluster address of the member.                                                         |
| `members[].diameter_label`  | string  | First label of the member's Diameter host.                                             |
| `members[].diameter_host`   | string  | Diameter host of the member.                                                           |
| `members[].label_generated` | boolean | Whether `diameter_label` is the default, from `node_id`.                               |
| `members[].display_name`    | string  | Display name of the member. Empty when unset. See [Update a Member](#update-a-member). |
| `members[].api_address`     | string  | API address of the member.                                                             |
| `members[].version`         | string  | Version of the member.                                                                 |
| `members[].joined_at`       | string  | Time the member joined.                                                                |
| `members[].drain_state`     | string  | `active`, `draining` or `drained`. See [Drain a Member](#drain-a-member).              |
| `members[].suffrage`        | string  | `voter`, `nonvoter` (joining, or standby), or `none`.                                  |
| `members[].leader`          | boolean | The member is the leader.                                                              |
| `members[].healthy`         | boolean | The member is healthy. Only from the leader.                                           |
| `members[].last_contact`    | string  | Time since the leader last heard from the member. Only from the leader.                |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "node_id": "0199f6a2-5c1e-7d3a-9b1f-2a4c6e8d0f12",
        "cluster_id": "0199f6a2-4a10-7e55-8c3d-1b2d3e4f5a6b",
        "clustered": true,
        "leader_id": "0199f6a2-5c1e-7d3a-9b1f-2a4c6e8d0f12",
        "term": 4,
        "applied_index": 18342,
        "commit_index": 18342,
        "schema": 1,
        "healthy": true,
        "failure_tolerance": 1,
        "members": [
            {
                "node_id": "0199f6a2-5c1e-7d3a-9b1f-2a4c6e8d0f12",
                "address": "10.0.0.1:7000",
                "api_address": "https://10.0.0.1:5020",
                "diameter_label": "paris-1",
                "diameter_host": "paris-1.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "label_generated": false,
                "display_name": "paris-1",
                "version": "v0.9.0",
                "joined_at": "2026-11-05T09:12:44Z",
                "drain_state": "active",
                "suffrage": "voter",
                "leader": true,
                "healthy": true
            },
            {
                "node_id": "0199f6a3-0b77-7c21-a4e0-6f1e2d3c4b5a",
                "address": "10.0.0.2:7000",
                "api_address": "https://10.0.0.2:5020",
                "diameter_label": "ims-6f1e2d3c4b5a",
                "diameter_host": "ims-6f1e2d3c4b5a.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "label_generated": true,
                "display_name": "",
                "version": "v0.9.0",
                "joined_at": "2026-11-05T09:14:02Z",
                "drain_state": "active",
                "suffrage": "voter",
                "leader": false,
                "healthy": true,
                "last_contact": "0s"
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Create a Join Token

This path returns a token that lets one node join the cluster, once.

| Method | Path                     |
| ------ | ------------------------ |
| POST   | `/api/v1/cluster/tokens` |

### Request Body

| Field         | Type | Required | Description                                          |
| ------------- | ---- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `ttl_seconds` | int  | No       | Validity of the token, 300 to 86400. Default `1800`. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "token": "AXsiaWQiOiI0ZjJk...",
        "expires_at": "2026-11-05T09:44:02Z"
    }
}
```

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                            |
| ----- | -------------------------------------- |
| `201` | The token.                             |
| `400` | `ttl_seconds` is out of range.         |
| `409` | The node has no `cluster` block.       |
| `410` | The node was removed from the cluster. |

## Join a Cluster

This path joins a node with no user to a cluster. It takes no access token.

| Method | Path                   |
| ------ | ---------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/cluster/join` |

### Request Body

| Field   | Type   | Required | Description                                               |
| ------- | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `token` | string | Yes      | A token from [Create a Join Token](#create-a-join-token). |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "token": "AXsiaWQiOiI0ZjJk..."
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "message": "Joined the cluster"
    }
}
```

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                                                                                |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `400` | The token is not valid or expired, or the node runs an older version than the cluster.                                                     |
| `403` | The node has a user.                                                                                                                       |
| `409` | The node is already in a cluster, or has no `cluster` block, the token was used, or a peer or another member has the node's Diameter host. |
| `429` | Too many attempts from the client address.                                                                                                 |
| `502` | No member answered.                                                                                                                        |

## Update a Member

This path sets the display name of a member.

| Method | Path                                |
| ------ | ----------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/cluster/members/{node_id}` |

### Request Body

| Field          | Type   | Required | Description                      |
| -------------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------- |
| `display_name` | string | Yes      | Up to 63 bytes. Empty clears it. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "display_name": "paris-1"
}
```

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                            |
| ----- | -------------------------------------- |
| `400` | The name is over 63 bytes.             |
| `404` | No such member.                        |
| `410` | The node was removed from the cluster. |

## Drain a Member

| Method | Path                                       |
| ------ | ------------------------------------------ |
| POST   | `/api/v1/cluster/members/{node_id}/drain`  |
| POST   | `/api/v1/cluster/members/{node_id}/resume` |

`drain` sets the member's `drain_state` to `draining`, then `drained`. `resume` sets it to `active`.

| Interface  | Draining or drained member                                                        |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Readiness  | [Fails](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/api/status/#check-readiness). |
| Leadership | Moves to another voter.                                                           |
| P-CSCF     | Answers `REGISTER` with `305 Use Proxy`.                                          |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                   |
| ----- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No such member.                               |
| `409` | The member is the only member of the cluster. |
| `410` | The node was removed from the cluster.        |

## Remove a Member

This path removes a drained member from the cluster. The removed node stops serving until its data directory is deleted.

| Method | Path                                |
| ------ | ----------------------------------- |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/cluster/members/{node_id}` |

### Query Parameters

| Name    | Type    | Description                                                                     |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `force` | boolean | `true` removes a member that is not drained, such as one that is down for good. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                   |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No such member.                                                               |
| `409` | The member is not drained, or the cluster would lose its majority without it. |
| `421` | The node is not the leader. See [Leader-Only Paths](#leader-only-paths).      |
| `503` | No leader. Retry.                                                             |

## Leader-Only Paths

[Remove a Member](#remove-a-member) and [Restore](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/api/backup/#restore) run on the leader only. Any other node answers `421`, with the leader's API address in `leader`.

| Field    | Type   | Description                                                 |
| -------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `error`  | string | The error.                                                  |
| `leader` | string | API address of the leader. Absent when the leader has none. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "error": "This node is not the cluster leader: send the request to https://10.0.0.1:5020",
    "leader": "https://10.0.0.1:5020"
}
```

# Diameter

Diameter peers are the HSSs, SLFs, PCRFs, DRAs, SMSCs, MMEs and SMSFs Ella IMS connects to. Routes set the realm the requests of each routed application go to.

## Get the Diameter Identity

This path returns the [Diameter identity](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/connectivity/#diameter-identity) of the node.

| Method | Path               |
| ------ | ------------------ |
| GET    | `/api/v1/diameter` |

### Response Fields

| Field   | Type   | Description              |
| ------- | ------ | ------------------------ |
| `host`  | string | Origin-Host of the node. |
| `realm` | string | Origin-Realm of the IMS. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "host": "ims.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "realm": "ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
    }
}
```

## List Diameter Peers

This path returns the list of Diameter peers, in the order they were created in.

| Method | Path                     |
| ------ | ------------------------ |
| GET    | `/api/v1/diameter/peers` |

### Response Fields

| Field                   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                    | string | Peer identifier, a UUIDv7.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `host`                  | string | DiameterIdentity of the peer, which must match the Origin-Host of its capabilities exchange. Empty takes the Origin-Host the peer gives.                                        |
| `address`               | string | IPv4 or IPv6 address, or host name, of the peer.                                                                                                                                |
| `port`                  | int    | Port of the peer.                                                                                                                                                               |
| `transport`             | string | `tcp` or `sctp`.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `applications`          | array  | Applications the peer serves: `cx` for an HSS or an SLF, and `sh` and `s6c` for its IP-SM-GW functions; `rx` for a PCRF or a DRA; `sgd` for an SMSC, an MME or an SMSF.         |
| `priority`              | int    | Requests try the peers serving their application by priority, lowest first, and share them between peers of the same priority. The peers of an SMS route are tried by priority. |
| `status`                | object | Connection to the peer.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `status.state`          | string | `down`, `connecting`, `open`, `suspect`, `reopen` or `closing`. `down` until the IMS has tried the peer.                                                                        |
| `status.since`          | string | Time of the last state change (RFC 3339).                                                                                                                                       |
| `status.remote_address` | string | Remote address of the connection.                                                                                                                                               |
| `status.host`           | string | Origin-Host the peer gave in its last capabilities exchange, else the configured host.                                                                                          |
| `status.realm`          | string | Origin-Realm the peer gave in its last capabilities exchange.                                                                                                                   |
| `status.error`          | string | Why the last connection to the peer failed.                                                                                                                                     |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "01a1796b-90b3-74bc-b148-bdc28999206e",
                "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "address": "127.0.0.1",
                "port": 3869,
                "transport": "tcp",
                "applications": ["cx"],
                "priority": 10,
                "status": {
                    "state": "down",
                    "since": "2026-10-26T18:14:14.963Z",
                    "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                    "error": "tcp: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:0->127.0.0.1:3869: connect: connection refused"
                }
            },
            {
                "id": "01a1796b-90bb-7a57-8972-269dab84d5af",
                "host": "",
                "address": "127.0.0.1",
                "port": 3870,
                "transport": "tcp",
                "applications": ["rx"],
                "priority": 10,
                "status": {
                    "state": "down",
                    "since": "2026-10-26T18:14:14.971Z",
                    "error": "tcp: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:0->127.0.0.1:3870: connect: connection refused"
                }
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Get a Diameter Peer

This path returns the details of a specific Diameter peer.

| Method | Path                          |
| ------ | ----------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/diameter/peers/{id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name | Type   | Description      |
| ---- | ------ | ---------------- |
| `id` | string | Peer identifier. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                  |
| ----- | ---------------------------- |
| `404` | No peer has this identifier. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": "01a1796b-90b3-74bc-b148-bdc28999206e",
        "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "address": "127.0.0.1",
        "port": 3869,
        "transport": "tcp",
        "applications": ["cx"],
        "priority": 10,
        "status": {
            "state": "down",
            "since": "2026-10-26T18:14:14.963Z",
            "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
            "error": "tcp: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:0->127.0.0.1:3869: connect: connection refused"
        }
    }
}
```

## Create a Diameter Peer

This path creates a Diameter peer, which the IMS then connects to.

| Method | Path                     |
| ------ | ------------------------ |
| POST   | `/api/v1/diameter/peers` |

### Request Body

| Field          | Type   | Required | Description                                                   |
| -------------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `host`         | string | No       | Domain name. Unique among peers.                              |
| `address`      | string | Yes      | Specific IPv4 or IPv6 address, or host name.                  |
| `port`         | int    | No       | 1–65535. Default `3868`.                                      |
| `transport`    | string | No       | `tcp` or `sctp`. Default `tcp`.                               |
| `applications` | array  | Yes      | At least one of `cx`, `rx`, `sh`, `s6c` and `sgd`, each once. |
| `priority`     | int    | No       | 0–65535. Default `10`.                                        |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                       |
| ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `409` | Another peer has the same host, or the same address and transport without a host. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
    "address": "127.0.0.1",
    "port": 3869,
    "transport": "tcp",
    "applications": ["cx"],
    "priority": 10
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": "01a1796b-90b3-74bc-b148-bdc28999206e",
        "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "address": "127.0.0.1",
        "port": 3869,
        "transport": "tcp",
        "applications": ["cx"],
        "priority": 10,
        "status": {
            "state": "down"
        }
    }
}
```

## Update a Diameter Peer

This path replaces a Diameter peer, which the IMS then reconnects to. The request body is that of [Create a Diameter Peer](#create-a-diameter-peer).

| Method | Path                          |
| ------ | ----------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/diameter/peers/{id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name | Type   | Description      |
| ---- | ------ | ---------------- |
| `id` | string | Peer identifier. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No peer has this identifier.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `409` | Another peer has the same host, or the same address and transport without a host; the policy interface is `rx` and no other peer serves `rx`; or an SMS route has the peer, which then needs `sgd` and a host. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
    "address": "127.0.0.1",
    "port": 3869,
    "transport": "tcp",
    "applications": ["cx"],
    "priority": 5
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": "01a1796b-90b3-74bc-b148-bdc28999206e",
        "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "address": "127.0.0.1",
        "port": 3869,
        "transport": "tcp",
        "applications": ["cx"],
        "priority": 5,
        "status": {
            "state": "down",
            "since": "2026-10-26T18:14:14.963Z",
            "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
            "error": "tcp: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:0->127.0.0.1:3869: connect: connection refused"
        }
    }
}
```

## Delete a Diameter Peer

This path deletes a Diameter peer.

| Method | Path                          |
| ------ | ----------------------------- |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/diameter/peers/{id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name | Type   | Description      |
| ---- | ------ | ---------------- |
| `id` | string | Peer identifier. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                               |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No peer has this identifier.                                                              |
| `409` | The policy interface is `rx` and no other peer serves `rx`, or an SMS route has the peer. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "message": "Diameter peer deleted"
    }
}
```

## List Diameter Routes

This path returns the route of each routed application: `cx`, `rx`, `sh`, then `s6c`.

| Method | Path                      |
| ------ | ------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/diameter/routes` |

### Response Fields

| Field               | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `application`       | string | `cx`, `rx`, `sh` or `s6c`.                                                                                                                    |
| `realm`             | string | Configured realm: of the HSS for `cx`, `sh` and `s6c`, of the PCRF for `rx`. Empty if not set.                                                |
| `destination_realm` | string | Destination-Realm of the requests. If `realm` is empty: the `cx` realm for `sh` and `s6c`, the domain derived from the MCC and MNC otherwise. |
| `peers`             | array  | Peers serving the application, in the order requests try them, each with its `id`, `host`, `priority` and `status`.                           |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "application": "cx",
                "realm": "epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "destination_realm": "epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "peers": [
                    {
                        "id": "01a1796b-90b3-74bc-b148-bdc28999206e",
                        "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                        "priority": 5,
                        "status": {
                            "state": "down",
                            "since": "2026-10-26T18:14:21.052Z",
                            "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                            "error": "tcp: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:0->127.0.0.1:3869: connect: connection refused"
                        }
                    }
                ]
            },
            {
                "application": "rx",
                "realm": "",
                "destination_realm": "ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "peers": [
                    {
                        "id": "01a1796b-90bb-7a57-8972-269dab84d5af",
                        "host": "",
                        "priority": 10,
                        "status": {
                            "state": "down",
                            "since": "2026-10-26T18:14:14.971Z",
                            "error": "tcp: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:0->127.0.0.1:3870: connect: connection refused"
                        }
                    }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

| Method | Path                                    |

```
                "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "priority": 10,
                "status": {
                    "state": "down",
```

# Initialize

## Initialize Ella IMS

This path creates the first user, an Admin, and logs it in.

| Method | Path           |
| ------ | -------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/init` |

### Request Body

| Field      | Type   | Required | Description    |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | -------------- |
| `email`    | string | Yes      | Email address. |
| `password` | string | Yes      | 8 to 72 bytes. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `201` | Created.                                   |
| `403` | A user exists.                             |
| `429` | Too many attempts from the client address. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "email": "admin@example.com",
    "password": "correct horse"
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "message": "System initialized successfully",
        "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
    }
}
```

# IP-SM-GW

The IP-SM-GW is Ella IMS's built-in IP Short Message Gateway: the Application Server that carries SMS over IP.

## Get the IP-SM-GW

This path returns the IP-SM-GW settings and name.

| Method | Path               |
| ------ | ------------------ |
| GET    | `/api/v1/ip-sm-gw` |

### Response Fields

| Field    | Type   | Description                                                                               |
| -------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `number` | string | E.164 number of the IP-SM-GW, without `+`. Empty if not set.                              |
| `name`   | string | SIP URI of the IP-SM-GW, the server name of its iFCs. Derived from the operator settings. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "number": "15550000100",
        "name": "sip:ipsmgw.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
    }
}
```

## Update the IP-SM-GW

This path sets the IP-SM-GW number. The IP-SM-GW registers the new number at the HSS for the users it serves. An empty number deregisters it.

| Method | Path               |
| ------ | ------------------ |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/ip-sm-gw` |

### Request Body

| Field    | Type   | Required | Description                                            |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `number` | string | Yes      | E.164 number of 1 to 15 digits, without `+`, or empty. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "number": "15550000100"
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "number": "15550000100",
        "name": "sip:ipsmgw.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
    }
}
```

## List SMS Routes

This path returns the SMS routes, ordered by identifier. An SMS route sends the short messages from phones of a service centre address to the Diameter peers of its SMS-IWMSC.

| Method | Path                      |
| ------ | ------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/ip-sm-gw/routes` |

### Response Fields

| Field            | Type   | Description                                                                                                                          |
| ---------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`             | string | Route identifier, a UUIDv7.                                                                                                          |
| `service_centre` | string | E.164 service centre address, without `+`. Empty for the default route, which serves the service centre addresses of no other route. |
| `peers`          | array  | Identifiers of the Diameter peers of the route. Short messages try them by peer priority, lowest first.                              |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "01a1796b-90b3-74bc-b148-bdc28999206e",
                "service_centre": "15550000000",
                "peers": ["01a1796b-90b3-74bc-b148-bdc28999206a"]
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Get an SMS Route

| Method | Path                           |
| ------ | ------------------------------ |
| GET    | `/api/v1/ip-sm-gw/routes/{id}` |

The response has the fields of [List SMS Routes](#list-sms-routes).

## Create an SMS Route

| Method | Path                      |
| ------ | ------------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/ip-sm-gw/routes` |

### Request Body

| Field            | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ---------------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `service_centre` | string | No       | E.164 number of 1 to 15 digits, without `+`, or empty for the default route. Unique among routes. Default empty. |
| `peers`          | array  | Yes      | At least one Diameter peer identifier, each once. Each peer serves `sgd` and has a host.                         |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                               |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `409` | Another route has the same service centre, or a peer does not serve `sgd` or has no host. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "service_centre": "15550000000",
    "peers": ["01a1796b-90b3-74bc-b148-bdc28999206a"]
}
```

## Update an SMS Route

| Method | Path                           |
| ------ | ------------------------------ |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/ip-sm-gw/routes/{id}` |

The request body and response codes are those of [Create an SMS Route](#create-an-sms-route).

## Delete an SMS Route

| Method | Path                           |
| ------ | ------------------------------ |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/ip-sm-gw/routes/{id}` |

# MCPTT Groups

An MCPTT group is a prearranged group (TS 24.481 §7.2) whose calls use AMR-WB. The `/api/v1/mcptt` paths answer `404` when the IMS does not run the MCPTT AS.

## List Groups

This path returns the list of groups, in the order they were created in.

| Method | Path                   |
| ------ | ---------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description               |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.       |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page. |

### Response Fields

| Field                            | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                                   |
| -------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `group_id`                       | string  | Group ID.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `display_name`                   | string  | Group name (TS 24.481 §7.2.2). Empty if none.                                                                                                                                 |
| `hang_timer_ms`                  | int     | How long a call lasts without anyone talking, T4 (TS 24.380 Table 11.1.3-1). `0` releases the call as soon as the floor is idle. Absent if not set, in which case it is 30 s. |
| `maximum_duration_ms`            | int     | How long a call lasts at most, TNG3 (TS 24.379 §6.3.3.5).                                                                                                                     |
| `release_on_initiator_leave`     | boolean | Whether a call ends when the member that started it leaves (TS 24.379 §6.3.8.1).                                                                                              |
| `members`                        | array   | Members of the group.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `members[].mcptt_id`             | string  | MCPTT ID of the member.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `members[].recvonly`             | boolean | Whether the member may listen but not talk.                                                                                                                                   |
| `members[].implicit_affiliation` | boolean | Whether the group is one of the member's `implicit_affiliations`.                                                                                                             |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
                "display_name": "Fire",
                "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
                "release_on_initiator_leave": false,
                "members": [
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                        "recvonly": false,
                        "implicit_affiliation": true
                    }
                ]
            },
            {
                "group_id": "sip:police@mcptt.example.com",
                "display_name": "Police",
                "hang_timer_ms": 10000,
                "maximum_duration_ms": 600000,
                "release_on_initiator_leave": true,
                "members": [
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                        "recvonly": false,
                        "implicit_affiliation": false
                    },
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
                        "recvonly": false,
                        "implicit_affiliation": true
                    }
                ]
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 2
    }
}
```

## Get a Group

This path returns the details of a specific group.

| Method | Path                              |
| ------ | --------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description                                         |
| ---------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID, for example `sip:fire@mcptt.example.com`. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                 |
| ----- | --------------------------- |
| `404` | No group has this group ID. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:police@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Police",
        "hang_timer_ms": 10000,
        "maximum_duration_ms": 600000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": true,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": false
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Create a Group

This path creates a group.

| Method | Path                   |
| ------ | ---------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups` |

### Request Body

| Field                            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                              |
| -------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `group_id`                       | string  | Yes      | SIP URI. Unique among users and groups.                                                                  |
| `display_name`                   | string  | No       | Up to 64 characters.                                                                                     |
| `hang_timer_ms`                  | int     | No       |                                                                                                          |
| `maximum_duration_ms`            | int     | Yes      | At least 1.                                                                                              |
| `release_on_initiator_leave`     | boolean | No       | Default `false`.                                                                                         |
| `members`                        | array   | No       |                                                                                                          |
| `members[].mcptt_id`             | string  | Yes      | MCPTT ID of a user.                                                                                      |
| `members[].recvonly`             | boolean | No       | Default `false`.                                                                                         |
| `members[].implicit_affiliation` | boolean | No       | Adds the group to, or removes it from, the user's `implicit_affiliations`. Absent leaves them unchanged. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                            |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `409` | The request conflicts with other users or groups, such as a member that is not a user. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
    "display_name": "Fire",
    "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
    "members": [
        {
            "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
            "implicit_affiliation": true
        },
        {
            "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
            "recvonly": true
        }
    ]
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Fire",
        "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": false,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": true,
                "implicit_affiliation": false
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Update a Group

This path replaces a group, members included. The request body is that of [Create a Group](#create-a-group); `group_id` is optional and, if present, must be that of the path. A member removed loses the group from its `implicit_affiliations`.

| Method | Path                              |
| ------ | --------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description |
| ---------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID.   |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                            |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No group has this group ID.                                                            |
| `409` | The request conflicts with other users or groups, such as a member that is not a user. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "display_name": "Police",
    "hang_timer_ms": 10000,
    "maximum_duration_ms": 600000,
    "release_on_initiator_leave": true,
    "members": [
        {
            "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com"
        },
        {
            "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
            "implicit_affiliation": true
        }
    ]
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:police@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Police",
        "hang_timer_ms": 10000,
        "maximum_duration_ms": 600000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": true,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": false
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Delete a Group

This path deletes a group. The group leaves the `implicit_affiliations` of its users, its affiliations are removed, and its call, if any, is released.

| Method | Path                              |
| ------ | --------------------------------- |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description |
| ---------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID.   |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                 |
| ----- | --------------------------- |
| `404` | No group has this group ID. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "message": "group deleted"
    }
}
```

## Add or Replace a Member

This path adds a user to the members of a group, after the others, or replaces the member where it is. It returns the group.

| Method | Path                                                 |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}/members/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description           |
| ---------- | ------ | --------------------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID.             |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the user. |

### Request Body

| Field                  | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id`             | string  | No       | Must be that of the path.                                                                                |
| `recvonly`             | boolean | No       | Default `false`.                                                                                         |
| `implicit_affiliation` | boolean | No       | Adds the group to, or removes it from, the user's `implicit_affiliations`. Absent leaves them unchanged. |

The body is required; `{}` takes the defaults.

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                 |
| ----- | --------------------------- |
| `200` | The member was replaced.    |
| `201` | The member was added.       |
| `404` | No group has this group ID. |
| `409` | The user does not exist.    |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "recvonly": false,
    "implicit_affiliation": true
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Fire",
        "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": false,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Remove a Member

This path removes a user from the members of a group. The group leaves the user's `implicit_affiliations`, and the user's clients are de-affiliated from it and leave its call, if any. It returns the group.

| Method | Path                                                 |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}/members/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description             |
| ---------- | ------ | ----------------------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID.               |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the member. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                              |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No group has this group ID, or the user is not a member. |
| `409` | The group would be invalid without the member.           |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Fire",
        "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": false,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

# MCPTT Live State

The registrations, affiliations and group calls the MCPTT AS holds in memory. The `/api/v1/mcptt` paths answer `404` when the IMS does not run the MCPTT AS.

## List Registrations

This path returns the list of MCPTT clients bound to their users by service authorisation, ordered by MCPTT ID and client ID.

| Method | Path                          |
| ------ | ----------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/registrations` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description               |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by MCPTT ID.       |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.       |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page. |

### Response Fields

| Field        | Type   | Description                                                                    |
| ------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `mcptt_id`   | string | MCPTT ID of the user.                                                          |
| `client_id`  | string | MCPTT client ID (TS 24.379 §4.10).                                             |
| `impu`       | string | IMS public user identity the client registered at.                             |
| `impus`      | array  | Public user identities the client is served at, `impu` first.                  |
| `since`      | string | When the client was authorised for the user (RFC 3339). Kept across refreshes. |
| `expires_at` | string | Expiry time (RFC 3339).                                                        |
| `contacts`   | array  | Contacts the client registered, in direct mode. Empty through the IMS.         |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                         |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| `503` | The MCPTT AS is restarting or busy. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "client_id": "urn:uuid:00000000-0000-1000-8000-000000000001",
                "impu": "sip:15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "impus": [
                    "sip:15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                    "tel:+15550000001"
                ],
                "since": "2026-10-26T18:40:02.118Z",
                "expires_at": "2026-10-26T19:40:02.118Z",
                "contacts": []
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 1
    }
}
```

## List Affiliations

This path returns the list of affiliations of clients to groups, ordered by group ID, MCPTT ID and client ID.

| Method | Path                         |
| ------ | ---------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/affiliations` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description               |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by MCPTT ID.       |
| `group_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by group ID.       |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.       |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page. |

### Response Fields

| Field       | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id`  | string  | MCPTT ID of the user.                                                                                                                                             |
| `client_id` | string  | MCPTT client ID.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `group_id`  | string  | Group ID.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `status`    | string  | Affiliation status at the participating function (TS 24.379 §9.2.2.2.2): `affiliating`, `affiliated` or `deaffiliating`. The first two count as affiliated.       |
| `implicit`  | boolean | `true` if the server affiliated the client from the user's `implicit_affiliations` (TS 24.379 §9.2.2.2.15); `false` if the client affiliated itself (§9.2.2.2.3). |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                         |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| `503` | The MCPTT AS is restarting or busy. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "client_id": "urn:uuid:00000000-0000-1000-8000-000000000001",
                "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
                "status": "affiliated",
                "implicit": true
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 1
    }
}
```

## List Group Calls

This path returns the list of group calls, oldest first.

| Method | Path                  |
| ------ | --------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/calls` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description                     |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by participant MCPTT ID. |
| `group_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by group ID.             |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.             |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page.       |

### Response Fields

| Field                     | Type    | Description                                                                               |
| ------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                      | string  | Call identifier, the "gr" of the MCPTT session identity.                                  |
| `session_id`              | string  | MCPTT session identity (TS 24.379 §4.5).                                                  |
| `group_id`                | string  | Group ID.                                                                                 |
| `originator`              | string  | MCPTT ID of the member that started the call.                                             |
| `created_at`              | string  | Creation time (RFC 3339).                                                                 |
| `started_at`              | string  | When the originator was answered (RFC 3339). `null` while the call is set up.             |
| `ends_at`                 | string  | When the maximum duration (TNG3) releases the call (RFC 3339). `null` if none.            |
| `talker`                  | object  | Participant with the floor, with its `mcptt_id` and `since`. `null` if the floor is idle. |
| `participants`            | array   | Members invited and joined, the originator first.                                         |
| `participants[].mcptt_id` | string  | MCPTT ID of the participant.                                                              |
| `participants[].state`    | string  | `invited` or `joined`.                                                                    |
| `participants[].required` | boolean | Whether the participant is required.                                                      |
| `participants[].recvonly` | boolean | Whether the participant may listen but not talk.                                          |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                         |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| `503` | The MCPTT AS is restarting or busy. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "XBDRKQ5VJ7T4M2N6P3HYWLC7AE",
                "session_id": "sip:mcptt-controlling@mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org;gr=XBDRKQ5VJ7T4M2N6P3HYWLC7AE",
                "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
                "originator": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "created_at": "2026-10-26T18:45:10.402Z",
                "started_at": "2026-10-26T18:45:10.655Z",
                "ends_at": "2026-10-26T18:50:10.655Z",
                "talker": {
                    "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                    "since": "2026-10-26T18:45:11.020Z"
                },
                "participants": [
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                        "state": "joined",
                        "required": false,
                        "recvonly": false
                    },
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                        "state": "invited",
                        "required": false,
                        "recvonly": true
                    }
                ]
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 1
    }
}
```

## Get a Group Call

This path returns a specific group call.

| Method | Path                            |
| ------ | ------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/calls/{call_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name      | Type   | Description      |
| --------- | ------ | ---------------- |
| `call_id` | string | Call identifier. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                         |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| `404` | No call has this identifier.        |
| `503` | The MCPTT AS is restarting or busy. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": "XBDRKQ5VJ7T4M2N6P3HYWLC7AE",
        "session_id": "sip:mcptt-controlling@mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org;gr=XBDRKQ5VJ7T4M2N6P3HYWLC7AE",
        "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
        "originator": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
        "created_at": "2026-10-26T18:45:10.402Z",
        "started_at": "2026-10-26T18:45:10.655Z",
        "ends_at": "2026-10-26T18:50:10.655Z",
        "talker": null,
        "participants": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "state": "joined",
                "required": false,
                "recvonly": false
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "state": "joined",
                "required": false,
                "recvonly": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

# MCPTT Service Configuration

The service configuration of the MCPTT organisation (TS 24.484 §8.4). The `/api/v1/mcptt` paths answer `404` when the IMS does not run the MCPTT AS.

## Get the Status of the MCPTT AS

This path returns what the MCPTT AS runs.

| Method | Path            |
| ------ | --------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt` |

### Response Fields

| Field               | Type   | Description                                             |
| ------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`              | string | `ims` or `direct`.                                      |
| `name`              | string | Server name of the AS in the iFCs of the HSS.           |
| `participating_psi` | string | Participating PSI.                                      |
| `controlling_psi`   | string | Controlling PSI.                                        |
| `sip`               | array  | SIP addresses of the AS. Sockets in `direct` mode only. |
| `media_control`     | string | Address of the floor control channels.                  |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mode": "ims",
        "name": "sip:mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "participating_psi": "sip:mcptt-participating@mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "controlling_psi": "sip:mcptt-controlling@mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "sip": ["127.0.0.1:5090"],
        "media_control": "127.0.0.1:21000"
    }
}
```

## Get the Service Configuration

This path returns the service configuration.

| Method | Path                                  |
| ------ | ------------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/service-configuration` |

### Response Fields

| Field                    | Type   | Description                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------ | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `domain`                 | string | Domain of the organisation, of its MCPTT IDs and group IDs, and the IOI of its charging. The IMS home domain until set. |
| `transmit_time_limit_ms` | int    | How long a participant may talk at a time, T2 (TS 24.380 Table 11.1.3-1). Absent if not set, in which case it is 30 s.  |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "domain": "ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
    }
}
```

## Update the Service Configuration

This path replaces the service configuration.

| Method | Path                                  |
| ------ | ------------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/mcptt/service-configuration` |

### Request Body

| Field                    | Type   | Required | Description                 |
| ------------------------ | ------ | -------- | --------------------------- |
| `domain`                 | string | Yes      | Domain of the organisation. |
| `transmit_time_limit_ms` | int    | No       | At least 1.                 |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "domain": "mcptt.example.com",
    "transmit_time_limit_ms": 30000
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "domain": "mcptt.example.com",
        "transmit_time_limit_ms": 30000
    }
}
```

# MCPTT Users

An MCPTT user (TS 24.484 §8.3) and the IMS public user identities its clients register at. The `/api/v1/mcptt` paths answer `404` when the IMS does not run the MCPTT AS.

## List Users

This path returns the list of users, in the order they were created in.

| Method | Path                  |
| ------ | --------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/users` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description               |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.       |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page. |

### Response Fields

| Field                   | Type   | Description                                                                         |
| ----------------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id`              | string | MCPTT ID of the user.                                                               |
| `alias`                 | string | Alias of the user (TS 24.484 §8.3.2.7). Empty if none.                              |
| `impus`                 | array  | IMS public user identities of the user, such as `sip:mcptt-<MSISDN>@<home domain>`. |
| `implicit_affiliations` | array  | Group IDs the user's clients are affiliated to when they register.                  |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "alias": "Alice",
                "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
                "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:fire@mcptt.example.com"]
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
                "alias": "Carol",
                "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000003@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
                "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:police@mcptt.example.com"]
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "alias": "Bob",
                "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000002@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
                "implicit_affiliations": []
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 3
    }
}
```

## Get a User

This path returns the details of a specific user.

| Method | Path                             |
| ------ | -------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/users/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description                                                      |
| ---------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the user, for example `sip:alice@mcptt.example.com`. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                |
| ----- | -------------------------- |
| `404` | No user has this MCPTT ID. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
        "alias": "Alice",
        "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
        "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:fire@mcptt.example.com"]
    }
}
```

## Create a User

This path creates a user.

| Method | Path                  |
| ------ | --------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/mcptt/users` |

### Request Body

| Field                   | Type   | Required | Description                                  |
| ----------------------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id`              | string | Yes      | SIP URI. Unique among users and groups.      |
| `alias`                 | string | No       | Up to 64 characters.                         |
| `impus`                 | array  | Yes      | At least one.                                |
| `implicit_affiliations` | array  | No       | Group IDs of groups the user is a member of. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                           |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `409` | The request conflicts with other users or groups, such as an MCPTT ID already in use. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
    "alias": "Alice",
    "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"]
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
        "alias": "Alice",
        "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
        "implicit_affiliations": []
    }
}
```

## Update a User

This path replaces a user. The request body is that of [Create a User](#create-a-user); `mcptt_id` is optional and, if present, must be that of the path.

| Method | Path                             |
| ------ | -------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/mcptt/users/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description           |
| ---------- | ------ | --------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the user. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                                                               |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No user has this MCPTT ID.                                                                                                |
| `409` | The request conflicts with other users or groups, such as an implicit affiliation to a group the user is not a member of. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "alias": "Carol",
    "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000003@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
    "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:police@mcptt.example.com"]
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
        "alias": "Carol",
        "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000003@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
        "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:police@mcptt.example.com"]
    }
}
```

## Delete a User

This path deletes a user. The user leaves its groups, and its clients are logged off and leave the group calls they are in.

| Method | Path                             |
| ------ | -------------------------------- |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/mcptt/users/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description           |
| ---------- | ------ | --------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the user. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                          |
| ----- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No user has this MCPTT ID.                           |
| `409` | A group the user leaves would be invalid without it. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "message": "user deleted"
    }
}
```

# Metrics

## Get Metrics

This path returns the metrics of the IMS in the [Prometheus exposition format](https://prometheus.io/docs/instrumenting/exposition_formats/#text-format-details), negotiated from the request's `Accept` header.

| Method | Path              |
| ------ | ----------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/metrics` |

### Sample Response

```
# HELP ellaims_active_calls Calls in progress: attempted and not yet ended.
# TYPE ellaims_active_calls gauge
ellaims_active_calls 0
# HELP ellaims_calls_total Calls that ended, by outcome, as their call records show it.
# TYPE ellaims_calls_total counter
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="answered"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="busy"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="cancelled"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="failed"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="no_answer"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="rejected"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="unavailable"} 0
# HELP ellaims_database_query_errors_total Database calls that failed, by connection pool. A record not found or in conflict is a result, not a failure.
# TYPE ellaims_database_query_errors_total counter
ellaims_database_query_errors_total{pool="local"} 0
ellaims_database_query_errors_total{pool="read"} 0
ellaims_database_query_errors_total{pool="write"} 0
# HELP ellaims_database_storage_bytes Size of the databases on disk, by file: the shared and node databases and their write-ahead logs.
# TYPE ellaims_database_storage_bytes gauge
ellaims_database_storage_bytes{file="main"} 4096
ellaims_database_storage_bytes{file="node"} 4096
ellaims_database_storage_bytes{file="node_wal"} 32992
ellaims_database_storage_bytes{file="wal"} 646872
```

# Single Sign-On

These paths configure sign-in to the UI through an OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider. They require Admin, and an access token: an API token gets `403`.

## Get the OIDC Settings

This path never returns the client secret.

| Method | Path           |
| ------ | -------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/oidc` |

### Response Fields

| Field                      | Type    | Description                                                                                                                               |
| -------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`                  | boolean | Users can sign in through the identity provider.                                                                                          |
| `external_url`             | string  | The URL users reach Ella IMS at.                                                                                                          |
| `redirect_url`             | string  | The redirect URL to register at the identity provider. Empty without an external URL.                                                     |
| `issuer`                   | string  | The identity provider's issuer URL.                                                                                                       |
| `client_id`                | string  | The client ID registered at the identity provider.                                                                                        |
| `client_secret_set`        | boolean | A client secret is stored.                                                                                                                |
| `display_name`             | string  | The name on the login button.                                                                                                             |
| `scopes`                   | array   | The scopes requested. Initially `openid`, `email` and `profile`.                                                                          |
| `session_lifetime_seconds` | int     | How long a session started through the identity provider lasts. Initially `86400`.                                                        |
| `trust_unverified_email`   | boolean | Email addresses are accepted when the identity provider does not send `email_verified`. An `email_verified` of `false` is always refused. |
| `ca_certificate`           | string  | PEM certificates the identity provider's TLS certificate must chain to. Empty: the system's.                                              |
| `groups_claim`             | string  | The claim, in the ID token or UserInfo, that holds the user's groups.                                                                     |
| `group_roles`              | array   | Group-to-role mappings, in order.                                                                                                         |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "enabled": true,
        "external_url": "https://ims.example.com",
        "redirect_url": "https://ims.example.com/api/v1/auth/oidc/callback",
        "issuer": "https://idp.example.com/realms/ims",
        "client_id": "ims",
        "client_secret_set": true,
        "display_name": "Keycloak",
        "scopes": ["openid", "email", "profile"],
        "session_lifetime_seconds": 86400,
        "trust_unverified_email": false,
        "ca_certificate": "",
        "groups_claim": "groups",
        "group_roles": [
            {"group": "ims-admins", "role_id": 1},
```
