```
            {"group": "noc", "role_id": 3}
        ]
    }
}
```

## Update the OIDC Settings

This path replaces the settings, which take effect at once. Disabling OIDC or changing the issuer ends all sessions started through the identity provider.

| Method | Path           |
| ------ | -------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/oidc` |

### Request Body

| Field                      | Type    | Required                                                                 | Description                                                                                                |
| -------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`                  | boolean | Yes                                                                      |                                                                                                            |
| `external_url`             | string  | When enabled                                                             | An https URL with no path. Stored as `https://host[:port]`.                                                |
| `issuer`                   | string  | When enabled                                                             | An https URL with no query or fragment, as the identity provider gives it.                                 |
| `client_id`                | string  | When enabled                                                             | At most 255 characters.                                                                                    |
| `client_secret`            | string  | When enabled and none is stored, or when `issuer` or `client_id` changes | At most 255 characters. Empty or absent: the stored secret is kept.                                        |
| `display_name`             | string  | When enabled                                                             | At most 64 characters.                                                                                     |
| `scopes`                   | array   | Yes                                                                      | At most 20, including `openid` and `email`.                                                                |
| `session_lifetime_seconds` | int     | Yes                                                                      | `300` to `2592000` (30 days).                                                                              |
| `trust_unverified_email`   | boolean | No                                                                       | Default `false`.                                                                                           |
| `ca_certificate`           | string  | No                                                                       | PEM certificates.                                                                                          |
| `groups_claim`             | string  | With `group_roles`                                                       | The claim name, such as `groups`.                                                                          |
| `group_roles`              | array   | No                                                                       | At most 100 objects with a `group`, matched exactly, and a `role_id`, `1` to `3`. Each group at most once. |

### Group Roles

| `group_roles` | At each login through the identity provider                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Empty         | An Admin sets the role. Someone with no user in Ella IMS is refused.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Not empty     | The first mapping whose group the user is in sets the role. A user in none is refused. Someone with no user in Ella IMS gets one, with that role. A [pinned](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/api/users/#update-a-user) role is kept, whatever the groups. The last Admin with a password stays Admin. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                  |
| ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200` | Updated. The response holds the new settings.                                |
| `400` | Invalid field, or `issuer` or `client_id` changes without a `client_secret`. |

## Test an Identity Provider

This path checks that Ella IMS can use an identity provider. It changes no setting.

| Method | Path                     |
| ------ | ------------------------ |
| POST   | `/api/v1/oidc/discovery` |

### Request Body

| Field            | Type   | Required | Description                                 |
| ---------------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `issuer`         | string | Yes      | The issuer URL to test.                     |
| `ca_certificate` | string | No       | PEM certificates to trust for the provider. |

### Response Fields

| Field                        | Type    | Description                                                                          |
| ---------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `issuer`                     | string  | The provider's issuer.                                                               |
| `authorization_endpoint`     | string  |                                                                                      |
| `token_endpoint`             | string  |                                                                                      |
| `token_endpoint_auth_method` | string  | `client_secret_basic` or `client_secret_post`: how Ella IMS sends the client secret. |
| `userinfo_endpoint`          | string  | Empty if the provider has none.                                                      |
| `jwks_uri`                   | string  |                                                                                      |
| `signing_algorithms`         | array   | The algorithms the provider signs ID tokens with.                                    |
| `keys`                       | int     | The number of signing keys.                                                          |
| `pkce`                       | boolean | The provider supports PKCE.                                                          |
| `issuer_parameter`           | boolean | The provider supports RFC 9207.                                                      |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200` | The provider can be used.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `400` | Invalid issuer or CA certificate.                                                                                                                                             |
| `502` | The provider cannot be reached or cannot be used, for example because its token endpoint supports neither `client_secret_basic` nor `client_secret_post`. The error says why. |

# Operator

The operator is the PLMN of the IMS, from which its Diameter identity derives, its home network domain, and the numbering plan that converts dial strings to E.164 numbers.

## Get the Operator

This path returns the operator settings.

| Method | Path               |
| ------ | ------------------ |
| GET    | `/api/v1/operator` |

### Response Fields

| Field                            | Type    | Description                                                                                                |
| -------------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcc`                            | string  | Mobile Country Code.                                                                                       |
| `mnc`                            | string  | Mobile Network Code.                                                                                       |
| `domain`                         | string  | Home network domain name. Empty: `ims.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org`, with the MNC padded to 3 digits. |
| `numbering`                      | object  | Conversion of dial strings to E.164 numbers.                                                               |
| `numbering.country_code`         | string  | Country code.                                                                                              |
| `numbering.national_prefix`      | string  | National prefix.                                                                                           |
| `numbering.international_prefix` | string  | International prefix.                                                                                      |
| `numbering.min_national_digits`  | integer | Fewest digits a number dialled without a prefix needs to be routed to a SIP trunk. `0`: never.             |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcc": "001",
        "mnc": "01",
        "domain": "",
        "numbering": {
            "country_code": "1",
            "national_prefix": "1",
            "international_prefix": "011",
            "min_national_digits": 7
        }
    }
}
```

## Update the Operator

This path replaces the operator settings. A change of MCC, MNC or domain restarts Diameter and SIP under the new names.

The domain derived from the MCC and MNC stays a home domain when `domain` is set.

| Method | Path               |
| ------ | ------------------ |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/operator` |

### Request Body

| Field                            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcc`                            | string  | Yes      | 3 digits.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `mnc`                            | string  | Yes      | 2 or 3 digits.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `domain`                         | string  | No       | Domain name of at least two labels, up to 253 characters, stored in lowercase. Under `3gppnetwork.org`, only the domain derived from the MCC and MNC. Default empty: derived from the MCC and MNC. |
| `numbering`                      | object  | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `numbering.country_code`         | string  | Yes      | 1 to 3 digits, not starting with 0.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `numbering.national_prefix`      | string  | Yes      | Up to 4 digits. Differs from `international_prefix` unless empty.                                                                                                                                  |
| `numbering.international_prefix` | string  | Yes      | Up to 4 digits.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `numbering.min_national_digits`  | integer | No       | 0 to 15. Default `7`. Fewest digits a number dialled without a prefix needs to be routed to a SIP trunk. `0`: never.                                                                               |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "mcc": "001",
    "mnc": "01",
    "domain": "",
    "numbering": {
        "country_code": "1",
        "national_prefix": "1",
        "international_prefix": "011",
        "min_national_digits": 7
    }
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcc": "001",
        "mnc": "01",
        "domain": "",
        "numbering": {
            "country_code": "1",
            "national_prefix": "1",
            "international_prefix": "011",
            "min_national_digits": 7
        }
    }
}
```

# Policy

The policy function is the interface the P-CSCF uses for policy control: none, Rx to a PCRF, or N5 to a PCF.

## Get the Policy

This path returns the policy function settings and the policy function running.

| Method | Path             |
| ------ | ---------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/policy` |

### Response Fields

| Field                   | Type    | Description                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `interface`             | string  | `none`, `rx` or `n5`.                                                          |
| `n5`                    | object  | Present for the `n5` interface only.                                           |
| `n5.pcf_uri`            | string  | API root of the PCF, `http[s]://host[:port][/prefix]`.                         |
| `status`                | object  | Policy function running. Differs from the settings while the IMS applies them. |
| `status.interface`      | string  | `none`, `rx` or `n5`.                                                          |
| `status.endpoint`       | string  | `rx` for Rx; the API root of the PCF for N5.                                   |
| `status.notify`         | string  | Address of the N5 notification listener.                                       |
| `status.last`           | object  | Outcome of the last request to the PCF. N5 only.                               |
| `status.last.at`        | string  | Time of the request (RFC 3339).                                                |
| `status.last.reachable` | boolean | Whether the PCF answered.                                                      |
| `status.last.result`    | string  | Result of the request.                                                         |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "interface": "rx",
        "status": {
            "interface": "rx",
            "endpoint": "rx"
        }
    }
}
```

## Update the Policy

This path replaces the policy function settings. Calls and registrations after the change use the new policy function.

| Method | Path             |
| ------ | ---------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/policy` |

### Request Body

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `interface`  | string | Yes      | `none`, `rx` or `n5`. `n5` requires `n5` in the configuration file.                                          |
| `n5`         | object | No       | For the `n5` interface only.                                                                                 |
| `n5.pcf_uri` | string | Yes      | `http[s]://host[:port][/prefix]`. `https` requires `n5.tls` in the configuration file, `http` requires none. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "interface": "none"
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "interface": "none",
        "status": {
            "interface": "rx",
            "endpoint": "rx"
        }
    }
}
```

# Pprof

These paths serve the [net/http/pprof](https://pkg.go.dev/net/http/pprof) API. They require Admin, and accept an API token.

## Profiling Endpoints

| Method    | Path                          | Description                                              |
| --------- | ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| GET       | `/api/v1/pprof/`              | An HTML page listing the available profiles.             |
| GET       | `/api/v1/pprof/allocs`        | A sampling of all past memory allocations.               |
| GET       | `/api/v1/pprof/cmdline`       | The command line invocation of the program.              |
| GET       | `/api/v1/pprof/goroutine`     | Stack traces of all current goroutines.                  |
| GET       | `/api/v1/pprof/goroutineleak` | Stack traces of all leaked goroutines.                   |
| GET       | `/api/v1/pprof/heap`          | A sampling of memory allocations of live objects.        |
| GET       | `/api/v1/pprof/profile`       | A CPU profile, of 30 seconds by default.                 |
| GET       | `/api/v1/pprof/threadcreate`  | Stack traces that led to the creation of new OS threads. |
| GET       | `/api/v1/pprof/trace`         | An execution trace, of 1 second by default.              |
| GET, POST | `/api/v1/pprof/symbol`        | Function names of program counters.                      |

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Paths                                         | Description                                                                         |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `seconds` | `profile`, `trace`                            | Duration of the capture.                                                            |
| `seconds` | `allocs`, `goroutine`, `heap`                 | Returns the difference of the profile over this duration.                           |
| `debug`   | `allocs`, `goroutine`, `heap`, `threadcreate` | `0`: protobuf. `1`: text. `2` (`goroutine`): stack traces in the format of a panic. |
| `gc`      | `heap`                                        | `1`: runs a garbage collection first.                                               |

# Registrations

A registration is a private user identity registered with the S-CSCF, with its registered implicit registration sets.

## List Registrations

This path returns the list of registered private identities.

| Method | Path                    |
| ------ | ----------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/registrations` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description                                |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `search`   | query | str  |         |         | Substring of a private or public identity. |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.                        |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page.                  |

### Response Fields

| Field                                     | Type    | Description                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `impi`                                    | string  | Private user identity.                                                                                                       |
| `implicit_registration_sets`              | array   | Registered implicit registration sets of the private identity. A set registers and deregisters as one (TS 23.228 §5.2.1a.0). |
| `implicit_registration_sets[].hss`        | object  | Origin-Host (`host`) and Origin-Realm (`realm`) of the last Cx answer for the set. Absent while unknown.                     |
| `implicit_registration_sets[].identities` | array   | Public user identities of the set.                                                                                           |
| `identities[].uri`                        | string  | Public user identity.                                                                                                        |
| `identities[].display_name`               | string  | Display name. Absent if none.                                                                                                |
| `identities[].barred`                     | boolean | Whether the identity is barred.                                                                                              |
| `identities[].registered_with`            | array   | Other private identities a request to this public identity reaches (TS 24.229 §5.4.3.3 step 8).                              |
| `implicit_registration_sets[].contacts`   | array   | Unexpired contacts bound to the set. A contact bound to several sets is listed in each.                                      |
| `contacts[].contact`                      | string  | Contact URI.                                                                                                                 |
| `contacts[].instance`                     | string  | Instance ID, an IMEI URN when available (TS 23.003 §13.8). Absent if none.                                                   |
| `contacts[].reg_id`                       | int     | reg-id of the flow (RFC 5626). Absent if none.                                                                               |
| `contacts[].q`                            | number  | q-value (RFC 3841 §7.2.3).                                                                                                   |
| `contacts[].media`                        | array   | Media the device registered for: `audio`, `video`.                                                                           |
| `contacts[].registered_at`                | string  | Registration time (RFC 3339).                                                                                                |
| `contacts[].expires_at`                   | string  | Expiry time (RFC 3339).                                                                                                      |
| `contacts[].address`                      | string  | Address and port of the device, as seen by the P-CSCF. Absent if unknown.                                                    |
| `contacts[].transport`                    | string  | `udp` or `tcp`. Absent if unknown.                                                                                           |
| `contacts[].protected`                    | boolean | Whether IPsec protects the signalling of the device.                                                                         |
| `contacts[].signalling_path`              | string  | State of the IMS signalling path of the device: `unmonitored`, `monitored` or `lost`.                                        |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "impi": "001010000000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "implicit_registration_sets": [
                    {
                        "hss": {
                            "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                            "realm": "epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
                        },
                        "identities": [
                            {
                                "uri": "sip:001010000000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                                "barred": true,
                                "registered_with": []
                            },
                            {
                                "uri": "tel:+15550000001",
                                "barred": false,
                                "registered_with": []
                            }
                        ],
                        "contacts": [
                            {
                                "contact": "sip:001010000000001@10.45.0.2:5064",
                                "instance": "urn:gsma:imei:35000000-000001-0",
                                "reg_id": 1,
                                "q": 1,
                                "media": ["audio", "video"],
                                "registered_at": "2026-10-26T18:20:04.512Z",
                                "expires_at": "2026-10-26T19:20:04.512Z",
                                "address": "10.45.0.2:5064",
                                "transport": "udp",
                                "protected": true,
                                "signalling_path": "monitored"
                            }
                        ]
                    }
                ]
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 1
    }
}
```

## Re-authenticate a Registration

This path brings forward the expiry of the bindings of a registered private identity and has its next REGISTER challenged (TS 24.229 §5.4.1.6).

| Method | Path                                          |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/registrations/{impi}/reauthenticate` |

### Path Parameters

| Name   | Type   | Description            |
| ------ | ------ | ---------------------- |
| `impi` | string | Private user identity. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                  |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `202` | Re-authentication started.                   |
| `404` | The private identity is not registered.      |
| `503` | The IMS is restarting to apply its settings. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "impi": "001010000000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
    }
}
```

# SIP

The SIP names of Ella IMS derive from the operator settings.

## Get SIP Information

This path returns the home domain, the host names the IMS answers to, and the SIP listeners.

| Method | Path          |
| ------ | ------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/sip` |

### Response Fields

| Field                    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------ | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `home_domain`            | string | Home network domain name: the operator `domain`, or the domain derived from the MCC and MNC if it is empty.                                                                                               |
| `aliases`                | array  | Host names the IMS answers to: the home domain, the domain derived from the MCC and MNC if it differs, the P-CSCF host name, and this node's S-CSCF host name, `scscf-<diameter label>.<derived domain>`. |
| `listeners`              | array  | SIP listeners.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `listeners[].role`       | string | `pcscf`, `pcscf-protected`, `icscf`, `scscf`, `ibcf`, `ibcf-external` or `ibcf-external-tls`.                                                                                                             |
| `listeners[].address`    | string | Address and port.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `listeners[].transports` | array  | Transports of the listener.                                                                                                                                                                               |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "home_domain": "ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "aliases": [
            "ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
            "pcscf.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
            "scscf-ims-a.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
        ],
        "listeners": [
            {
                "role": "pcscf",
                "address": "127.0.0.1:5060",
                "transports": ["udp", "tcp"]
            },
            {
                "role": "pcscf-protected",
                "address": "127.0.0.1:5063",
                "transports": ["udp", "tcp"]
            },
            {
                "role": "pcscf-protected",
                "address": "127.0.0.1:5064",
                "transports": ["udp", "tcp"]
            },
            {
                "role": "pcscf-protected",
                "address": "127.0.0.1:5065",
                "transports": ["udp", "tcp"]
            },
            {
                "role": "icscf",
                "address": "127.0.0.1:5070",
                "transports": ["udp", "tcp"]
            },
            {
                "role": "scscf",
                "address": "127.0.0.1:5080",
                "transports": ["udp", "tcp"]
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

# SIP Trunks

SIP trunks connect Ella IMS to carriers. SIP routes pick the trunks of a call by the prefix of the number. See [SIP Trunks](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/explanation/sip_trunks/index.md).

## List SIP Trunks

This path returns the list of SIP trunks, ordered by identifier.

| Method | Path                 |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/sip-trunks` |

### Response Fields

| Field                        | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                         | string  | Trunk identifier, a UUIDv7.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `name`                       | string  | Name of the trunk.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `addresses`                  | array   | Where requests to the carrier go, in order.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `addresses[].host`           | string  | Domain name, or IPv4 or IPv6 address.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `addresses[].port`           | int     | Port. Absent if not set.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `addresses[].transport`      | string  | `udp`, `tcp` or `tls`. Absent if not set.                                                                                                                                                            |
| `inbound_cidrs`              | array   | Networks that requests from the carrier come from. Empty if not set.                                                                                                                                 |
| `domain`                     | string  | Host of the Request-URI of requests to the carrier. Empty if not set.                                                                                                                                |
| `trusted`                    | boolean | Whether the carrier is in the trust domain.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `keepalive_interval`         | int     | Seconds between keepalives to the carrier. `0`: no OPTIONS requests.                                                                                                                                 |
| `enabled`                    | boolean | Whether the trunk carries calls, in both directions.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `tls`                        | object  | TLS with the carrier. See [TLS](#tls).                                                                                                                                                               |
| `tls.required`               | boolean | Whether the carrier must use TLS, with a certificate.                                                                                                                                                |
| `tls.ca_certificates`        | string  | PEM-encoded CA certificates. Empty if none.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `tls.pins`                   | array   | SHA-256 fingerprints of pinned certificates, as upper-case hex bytes separated by colons.                                                                                                            |
| `tls.identities`             | array   | Domain names one of which the carrier's certificate must hold. Empty if not set.                                                                                                                     |
| `tls.ca_certificate_details` | array   | One entry per CA certificate, in order. See [Certificate Details](#certificate-details).                                                                                                             |
| `effective.domain`           | string  | `domain` in use, default included.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `effective.inbound_cidrs`    | array   | `inbound_cidrs` in use, default included.                                                                                                                                                            |
| `effective.tls_identities`   | array   | `tls.identities` in use, default included.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `status.state`               | string  | `up`: the carrier answers OPTIONS requests. `down`: it does not; routes skip the trunk. `unknown`: not probed. `unusable`: conflicts with the configuration file or another trunk; carries no calls. |
| `status.since`               | string  | Time of the last state change (RFC 3339). Absent while `unknown`.                                                                                                                                    |

### Certificate Details

| Field                | Type    | Description                                                       |
| -------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subject`            | string  | Subject distinguished name.                                       |
| `issuer`             | string  | Issuer distinguished name.                                        |
| `dns_names`          | array   | DNS names of the subjectAltName.                                  |
| `uris`               | array   | URIs of the subjectAltName.                                       |
| `ip_addresses`       | array   | IP addresses of the subjectAltName.                               |
| `identities`         | array   | Identities matched against `tls.identities`.                      |
| `ca`                 | boolean | Whether the certificate is a CA certificate.                      |
| `not_before`         | string  | Start of validity (RFC 3339).                                     |
| `not_after`          | string  | End of validity (RFC 3339).                                       |
| `sha256_fingerprint` | string  | SHA-256 fingerprint, as upper-case hex bytes separated by colons. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "019a5a3e-1b2c-7d4e-8f60-1a2b3c4d5e6f",
                "name": "Carrier",
                "addresses": [
                    {
                        "host": "sip.carrier.example",
                        "transport": "tcp"
                    }
                ],
                "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
                "domain": "",
                "trusted": true,
                "keepalive_interval": 30,
                "enabled": true,
                "tls": {
                    "required": false,
                    "ca_certificates": "",
                    "pins": [],
                    "identities": [],
                    "ca_certificate_details": []
                },
                "effective": {
                    "domain": "sip.carrier.example",
                    "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
                    "tls_identities": []
                },
                "status": {
                    "state": "up",
                    "since": "2026-11-06T10:00:00.000Z"
                }
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

This path returns the details of a specific SIP trunk.

### Path Parameters

| Name | Type   | Description       |
| ---- | ------ | ----------------- |
| `id` | string | Trunk identifier. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                   |
| ----- | ----------------------------- |
| `404` | No trunk has this identifier. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": "019a5a3e-1b2c-7d4e-8f60-1a2b3c4d5e6f",
        "name": "Carrier",
        "addresses": [
            {
                "host": "sip.carrier.example",
                "transport": "tcp"
            }
        ],
        "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
        "domain": "",
        "trusted": true,
        "keepalive_interval": 30,
        "enabled": true,
        "tls": {
            "required": false,
            "ca_certificates": "",
            "pins": [],
            "identities": [],
            "ca_certificate_details": []
        },
        "effective": {
            "domain": "sip.carrier.example",
            "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
            "tls_identities": []
        },
        "status": {
            "state": "up",
            "since": "2026-11-06T10:00:00.000Z"
        }
    }
}
```

## Create a SIP Trunk

This path creates a SIP trunk.

| Method | Path                 |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/sip-trunks` |

### Request Body

| Field                   | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name`                  | string  | Yes      | 1 to 64 printable characters, without leading or trailing spaces. Unique among trunks, ignoring case.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `addresses`             | array   | Yes      | At least one, each once, none reaching the same server as an address of another trunk: the same host, with a port and a transport that can match once their defaults apply. See [Addresses and DNS](#addresses-and-dns).                                                                                                                                     |
| `addresses[].host`      | string  | Yes      | Domain name, or specific IPv4 or IPv6 address.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `addresses[].port`      | int     | No       | 1–65535.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `addresses[].transport` | string  | No       | `udp`, `tcp` or `tls`. `tls` needs `tls.ca_certificates` or `tls.pins`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `inbound_cidrs`         | array   | No       | Networks, such as `198.51.100.0/24`, or single addresses. No two may overlap, in this trunk or across trunks. None may overlap `sip.addresses` or `sip.trusted_networks` of the [configuration file](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/config_file/index.md). Not `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0`. Default: the IP addresses among the hosts of `addresses`. |
| `domain`                | string  | No       | Domain name, or specific IPv4 or IPv6 address, without brackets. Default: the first domain name among the hosts of `addresses`. Required if every host is an IP address.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `trusted`               | boolean | No       | Default `false`. A trusted trunk never uses UDP: no address may have `udp` as transport.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `keepalive_interval`    | int     | No       | 5–3600 seconds, or `0` for no OPTIONS requests. Default `30`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `enabled`               | boolean | No       | Default `true`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `tls`                   | object  | No       | Absent for a trunk without TLS. See [TLS](#tls).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `tls.required`          | boolean | No       | Default `false`. Every address must have `tls` as transport. Requires `ibcf.external.tls` in the [configuration file](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/config_file/index.md).                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `tls.ca_certificates`   | string  | No       | PEM-encoded CA certificates, at most 32.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `tls.pins`              | array   | No       | At most 32, each a PEM-encoded certificate, or a SHA-256 fingerprint as 32 hex bytes, with or without colons.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `tls.identities`        | array   | No       | Domain names, at most 16. Default: `domain` and the domain names among the hosts of `addresses`. Required with `tls.ca_certificates` if there are none.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

### Addresses and DNS

| `host`      | `transport` | `port`   | Requests go to                                                                       |
| ----------- | ----------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Domain name | —           | —        | The NAPTR, then SRV, then A and AAAA records of the domain.                          |
| Domain name | Set         | —        | The SRV records for that transport, else the A and AAAA records at the default port. |
| Domain name | Set or —    | Set      | The A and AAAA records, at that port, over that transport, else UDP.                 |
| IP address  | Set or —    | Set or — | That address, at that port, else the default port, over that transport, else UDP.    |

The default port is `5060` for `udp` and `tcp`, and `5061` for `tls`. A trusted trunk skips UDP records, and uses TCP instead of UDP.

### TLS

| Carrier authenticated by | Field                 | Carrier's certificate must hold                              |
| ------------------------ | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| A CA                     | `tls.ca_certificates` | One of `tls.identities`                                      |
| Its own certificate      | `tls.pins`            | One of `tls.identities`, unless the address is an IP address |

An identity is the host of a `sip` URI or a DNS name in the certificate's subjectAltName, or its common name if it has none.

| TLS connection opened by | Extended key usage of each certificate of the carrier's chain, if present |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Ella IMS                 | `serverAuth`, `anyExtendedKeyUsage` or `id-kp-sipDomain`                  |
| The carrier              | `clientAuth`, `anyExtendedKeyUsage` or `id-kp-sipDomain`                  |

With `tls.required`, the carrier must use TLS, and present a certificate on the TLS connections it opens.

CA certificates and PEM pins must not be expired when added. Ella IMS keeps the fingerprint of a PEM pin only.

Ella IMS's own certificate is `ibcf.external.tls` in the [configuration file](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/config_file/index.md).

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                                                                                               |
| ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `400` | A field is invalid, an inbound network overlaps the networks of the configuration file, or `tls.required` is set without `ibcf.external.tls`.             |
| `409` | Another trunk has the same name, an address that reaches the same server as one of this trunk's, or an inbound network that overlaps one of this trunk's. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "name": "Carrier",
    "addresses": [
        {
            "host": "sip.carrier.example",
            "transport": "tcp"
        }
    ],
    "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
    "trusted": true
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": "019a5a3e-1b2c-7d4e-8f60-1a2b3c4d5e6f",
        "name": "Carrier",
        "addresses": [
            {
                "host": "sip.carrier.example",
                "transport": "tcp"
            }
        ],
        "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
        "domain": "",
        "trusted": true,
        "keepalive_interval": 30,
        "enabled": true,
        "tls": {
            "required": false,
            "ca_certificates": "",
            "pins": [],
            "identities": [],
            "ca_certificate_details": []
        },
        "effective": {
            "domain": "sip.carrier.example",
            "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
            "tls_identities": []
        },
        "status": {
            "state": "unknown"
        }
    }
}
```

### Sample Request with TLS

```
{
    "name": "Carrier",
    "addresses": [
        {
            "host": "sip.carrier.example",
            "transport": "tls"
        }
    ],
    "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
    "trusted": true,
    "tls": {
        "required": true,
        "ca_certificates": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nMIIBczCCARigAwIBAgII...\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n"
    }
}
```

The `tls` object of its response:

```
{
    "required": true,
    "ca_certificates": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nMIIBczCCARigAwIBAgII...\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n",
    "pins": [],
    "identities": [],
    "ca_certificate_details": [
        {
            "subject": "CN=Carrier CA,O=Carrier",
            "issuer": "CN=Carrier CA,O=Carrier",
            "dns_names": [],
            "uris": [],
            "ip_addresses": [],
            "identities": [],
            "ca": true,
            "not_before": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
            "not_after": "2036-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
            "sha256_fingerprint": "2C:54:DF:66:29:19:96:C5:C8:A5:E8:4B:7A:32:FE:71:02:38:11:62:D4:D9:2E:2C:A1:C4:E7:8C:0D:D5:B1:C5"
        }
    ]
}
```

## Update a SIP Trunk

This path replaces a SIP trunk. The request body is that of [Create a SIP Trunk](#create-a-sip-trunk). A field left out takes its default. A response is a valid request body without `id`, `effective`, `status` and `tls.ca_certificate_details`.

| Method | Path                      |
| ------ | ------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/sip-trunks/{id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name | Type   | Description       |
| ---- | ------ | ----------------- |
| `id` | string | Trunk identifier. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                                                                                               |
| ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `400` | A field is invalid, an inbound network overlaps the networks of the configuration file, or `tls.required` is set without `ibcf.external.tls`.             |
| `404` | No trunk has this identifier.                                                                                                                             |
| `409` | Another trunk has the same name, an address that reaches the same server as one of this trunk's, or an inbound network that overlaps one of this trunk's. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "name": "Carrier",
    "addresses": [
        {
            "host": "sip.carrier.example",
            "transport": "tcp"
        }
    ],
    "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
    "trusted": true,
    "enabled": false
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": "019a5a3e-1b2c-7d4e-8f60-1a2b3c4d5e6f",
        "name": "Carrier",
        "addresses": [
            {
                "host": "sip.carrier.example",
                "transport": "tcp"
            }
        ],
        "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
        "domain": "",
        "trusted": true,
        "keepalive_interval": 30,
        "enabled": false,
        "tls": {
            "required": false,
            "ca_certificates": "",
            "pins": [],
            "identities": [],
            "ca_certificate_details": []
        },
        "effective": {
            "domain": "sip.carrier.example",
            "inbound_cidrs": ["198.51.100.10/32", "198.51.100.11/32"],
            "tls_identities": []
        },
        "status": {
            "state": "unknown"
        }
    }
}
```

## Delete a SIP Trunk

This path deletes a SIP trunk that no route uses.

| Method | Path                      |
| ------ | ------------------------- |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/sip-trunks/{id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name | Type   | Description       |
| ---- | ------ | ----------------- |
| `id` | string | Trunk identifier. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                   |
| ----- | ----------------------------- |
| `404` | No trunk has this identifier. |
| `409` | A route uses the trunk.       |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "message": "SIP trunk deleted"
    }
}
```

## List SIP Routes

This path returns the list of SIP routes, ordered by identifier.

| Method | Path                 |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/sip-routes` |

### Response Fields

| Field    | Type   | Description                                                                                                          |
| -------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | string | Route identifier, a UUIDv7.                                                                                          |
| `prefix` | string | Start of the E.164 numbers the route takes, with `+`. The longest matching prefix wins. Empty for the default route. |
| `trunks` | array  | Identifiers of the trunks of the route, in the order calls try them.                                                 |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "019a5a3f-0c1d-7e2f-9a3b-4c5d6e7f8091",
                "prefix": "",
                "trunks": ["019a5a3e-1b2c-7d4e-8f60-1a2b3c4d5e6f"]
            },
            {
                "id": "019a5a3f-2a3b-7c4d-8e5f-60718293a4b5",
                "prefix": "+1",
                "trunks": ["019a5a3e-1b2c-7d4e-8f60-1a2b3c4d5e6f", "019a5a3e-5f6a-7b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e"]
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

```
    }
```

## Create a SIP Route

This path creates a SIP route.

| Method | Path                 |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/sip-routes` |

### Request Body

| Field    | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                        |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `prefix` | string | No       | `+` followed by 1 to 15 digits, not starting with `0`. Absent or empty for the default route. Unique among routes. |
| `trunks` | array  | Yes      | Identifiers of existing trunks, at least one, each once.                                                           |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                       |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `400` | The prefix is invalid, or a trunk does not exist. |
| `409` | Another route has the same prefix.                |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "prefix": "+1",
    "trunks": ["019a5a3e-1b2c-7d4e-8f60-1a2b3c4d5e6f", "019a5a3e-5f6a-7b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e"]
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": "019a5a3f-2a3b-7c4d-8e5f-60718293a4b5",
        "prefix": "+1",
        "trunks": ["019a5a3e-1b2c-7d4e-8f60-1a2b3c4d5e6f", "019a5a3e-5f6a-7b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e"]
    }
}
```
